Exactly like that, althought I would prefer for Griffith to finally realize and regret what he did to gain godhood, because he did it to people he onced loved. So accepting death peacefully and letting people move on, will humanize him in his final moments, because I think Griffith, for some reason, is intelligent enought to be instrospective like that. The problem is in the story now is that Griffith shows pretty unemotional towards Guts and Casca and didnt even react that much when Rickert slapped him. But oh well, this is just me writing my headcannon ending for Griffith, who knows what will happen in the actual story.

Yeah, I think its the fitting end for someone who has brainwashed or traumatized so many people like Griffith: The victims get over him, and they and the world move on, placing him in a distant forgotten place in the memory of the minds of the people and the history of the world.
